name: ui-layouts-spotlight

frames.best_why: Frame 3 shows a bright radial spotlight sweeping across the top card; frames 1-2 show only a faint glow.

tagline: A soft white glow follows the pointer across a stack of cards.
summary: Three dark feature cards that light up with a radial glow wherever the cursor moves. The light falls off gently and nothing on the cards is interactive.
appearance: Three stacked dark cards with rounded corners and faint borders, each holding a small bold title and two lines of grey body text. A soft white radial glow sits on one card wherever the cursor is.
behaviour: Moving the pointer lights a soft radial patch that tracks it across the cards, brightening the area under the cursor and fading to nothing toward the edges. Nothing is clickable.
demo_content: Three feature cards: Proximity Spotlight, Hover Focus, Cursor Flow Gradient
search_phrases: glow follows the mouse across cards
dark cards with a moving glow
soft light that follows my mouse
use_when: A feature grid needs a subtle focal cue tied to where the pointer is.
avoid_when: Pointer-driven only, so touch and keyboard users never see the glow.
customise: ProximitySpotlight, HoverFocusSpotlight, CursorFlowGradient and className are props on the wrapper; glow colour and size are fixed.
weight_why: A mousemove listener updating gradients; no canvas or loop.

a11y.note: Pure pointer decoration: no focusable parts and no reduced-motion guard.

issues: The glow only reacts to a mouse, so touch devices see a static grid.
Body text under the brightest part of the glow loses contrast.
polish_why: Restrained glow that follows the pointer well; touch and reduced-motion cases are unhandled.
title: Spotlight Effect
